dead_confidence_justification: Vulture defines 100% findings as definite unused arguments/variables and unreachable code. complexity.reviewed_ledger_read_expiry_debug_demote:
Promoting the self-healing managed-read-expiry deferral log line to a module-level SSOT message
constant (MANAGED_READ_EXPIRY_DEFERRED_LOG_MESSAGE) and demoting it from WARNING to DEBUG marginally
lowers this file's maintainability index (max CC unchanged at 34; MI 29.6357 -> 29.5825). The demote
is a deliberate, reviewed observability change: the deferral is routine under connection-step-lock
contention and self-healing (the background expiry sweep re-schedules; outcome flag
MANAGED_READ_CLEANUP_DEFERRED), so DEBUG is the correct level. It stops production WARNING log spam and
benign leakage into tests that assert logger silence, while hiding no terminal error (raised
LedgerQueryDeadline/LedgerReadTimeout paths are unchanged and still surface). The SSOT constant removes
a duplicated string literal so the one observability assertion can import it rather than re-hardcode it.
Reviewed and accepted as part of closing the busy-connection / ledger-read-expiry timing flake family.
